scope: The v2 finite replay proved component selection/global accounting and independently verified an explicit all-true hybrid witness, but the outer replay did not construct that witness by disjoint-union remapping of the actual inner witnesses returned by the selected representation lanes.
mathematical_effect: CP2 remains an exact analytic theorem for variable-disjoint components. The implementation gap affects only whether the finite provider replay exercised the proof-carrying witness-glue path itself.
repair_rule: Outer witness must be built exclusively from selected component witness payloads, remapped local-to-global using the immutable manifest, checked for overlap/conflict/completeness, then independently evaluated against the original monolithic hybrid.
